# Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Navigation

MauiShellNavigator maps ViewModel types to Shell routes. INavigator is in Core.

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Navigation
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-mvvmexpress/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 0.1.0-preview (`--prerelease`)

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Navigation --prerelease

Depends on Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress (host).

## Use this package when

- The MAUI app uses Shell and wants ViewModel → route navigation with typed query args

## Do not use when

- They need Prism-style page stack / regions — not shipped
- Tests only — use Core `InMemoryNavigator` or Testing `FakeNavigator`

## Alternatives

Prism.Maui (page navigation, no Shell), MAUI `Shell.GoToAsync` directly.
